start.obj: Visit Vesk at the station in the old fortress

desk.label: p_look
lines: n_hero: Zoé's connections board. Green pins are on the project's heat, red ones still wait. Bug Street is green. The harbour row is all red.
n_hero: (She sends the office a new list every week. If anyone knows who's been left out, it's her.)

trunk.label: p_look
lines: n_hero: The old travel trunk. Desert Island, Zeelich... these days it holds seed packets.

mend.label: p_look
lines: n_hero: Things to take back: Gilbert's kettle, the baker's scales. Gilbert will want the kettle before he wants to say thanks.

meter.label: p_look
lines: n_hero: Zoé's note on the meter: "Jumps when the ground hums. Three times today. -Z"
n_hero: (She noticed before I did. Again.)

bench.label: p_look
lines: n_hero: Arthur's paddle boat, built to beat Lulu's. The plan says "rudder needs pin (pliers?)". So that's where my pliers went.
